newsitem.title: UK: Brazil's Sabesp plans $200 million Eurobond -paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Sabesp plans $200 million Eurobond -paper.

text.p: Sao Paulo state's sewage company Sabesp plans to launch a $200 million Eurobond by June, the Financial Times reported on Wednesday.
It would use the funds to replace existing debt with cheaper funding, the paper said, quoting Sabesp representative Claudio Gaiarsa.
Sabesp was also considering sub-concessions to foreign water companies to raise capital, the paper said.

Sabesp operates concessions granted by Sao Paulo's municipalities, and in December 1996 provided water and sewage services to 22 million people, nearly 60 percent of Sao Paulo state's population, in 329 municipalities.
